eyebrow: Search a directory tree by name and type
caption: -name matches a filename pattern; -type d narrows to directories
-size finds files over a given size; -mtime finds files older than N days
{} is the current file, \; ends the command — deletes old logs, no loop

code:
$ find backups -name "*.bak" -mtime +7 | xargs rm -v
removed 'backups/db-2026-09-20.bak'

$ cat servers.txt | xargs -I{} ssh {} "uptime"
caption: xargs turns piped-in filenames into arguments for another command

subtitle: How the shell decides which command actually runs.
